groot-pawn.label: Living Barricade
groot-pawn.description: These pawns begin shielded and may grow diagonally forward into an empty square.

groot-rook.label: Strangler Gate
groot-rook.description: These rooks begin shielded and may vault through one allied piece on each file or rank.

groot-knight.label: Branchline Rescue
groot-knight.description: These knights gain one-square diagonal steps; losing one shields every surviving knight.

groot-bishop.label: Rootway Passage
groot-bishop.description: These bishops begin shielded and may pass through one allied piece on a diagonal.

groot-queen.label: Flora Colossus
groot-queen.description: The queen may pass through one ally per line and gains a shield after every capture.

groot-king.label: Heart of Yggdrasil
groot-king.description: The king may dash two clear orthogonal squares once; adjacent allies begin shielded.

hulk-pawn.label: Gamma Breaker
hulk-pawn.description: These pawns may capture straight ahead and gain a shield after a successful capture.

hulk-rook.label: Seismic Juggernaut
hulk-rook.description: These rooks vault through one ally and armor themselves with a shield after capturing.

hulk-knight.label: Gamma Bound
hulk-knight.description: These knights gain two-square cardinal jumps and shield themselves after capturing.

hulk-bishop.label: Shockwave Cross
hulk-bishop.description: These bishops may jump exactly two orthogonal squares and shield after moves of three or more squares.

hulk-queen.label: Worldbreaker Order
hulk-queen.description: The queen may make one two-square cardinal jump; her first capture grants another turn.

hulk-king.label: Strongest Crown
hulk-king.description: The king may dash two clear cardinal squares once and shields adjacent allies whenever it moves.

iron-man-pawn.label: Boosted Vanguard
iron-man-pawn.description: These pawns may launch three squares on their first move and shield after traveling three squares.

iron-man-rook.label: Repulsor Relay
iron-man-rook.description: Each rook has one knight leap and gains a shield after any three-square flight.

iron-man-knight.label: Flight Vector
iron-man-knight.description: These knights gain extended 3-by-1 leaps and shield after covering at least three squares.

iron-man-bishop.label: Unibeam Transit
iron-man-bishop.description: Each bishop has one knight leap and gains a shield after a long diagonal flight.

iron-man-queen.label: House Party

iron-man-king.label: Veronica Protocol
iron-man-king.description: The king may dash two clear diagonal squares once, shields adjacent allies after moving, and fortifies them at deployment.

spider-man-pawn.label: Web-Swing Advance
spider-man-pawn.description: These pawns may swing diagonally into empty squares and gain a shield after capturing.

spider-man-rook.label: Wallcrawler Circuit
spider-man-rook.description: These rooks gain diagonal single steps; their side's first rook capture grants another turn.

spider-man-knight.label: Spider-Sense Leap
spider-man-knight.description: These knights gain 3-by-1 leaps; their first capture bends time for an extra turn.

spider-man-bishop.label: Web-Zip Cross
spider-man-bishop.description: These bishops gain adjacent cardinal steps and trigger an extra turn on their first capture.

spider-man-queen.label: Great Web Reversal
spider-man-queen.description: The queen has one knight leap; her first capture immediately returns control to her side.

spider-man-king.label: Thwip Escape
spider-man-king.description: The king may use one knight leap; after a capture it shields every adjacent ally.

thor-pawn.label: Mjolnir Breach
thor-pawn.description: These pawns may capture straight ahead; the first successful breach grants another turn.

thor-rook.label: Storm Corridor

thor-knight.label: Bifrost Landing

thor-bishop.label: Thunder Crossroads
thor-bishop.description: These bishops begin shielded and may jump exactly two clear orthogonal squares.

thor-queen.label: Godblast Arc

thor-king.label: Allfather Charge
thor-king.description: The king may dash two clear cardinal squares once; capturing shields adjacent allies.

bastion-pawn.label: Configuration: Fortify

bastion-knight.label: Recon Pivot

bastion-bishop.label: Artillery Line

bastion-queen.label: Tank Configuration

bastion-king.label: Ganymede Bunker

genji-pawn.label: Swift Strike File

genji-bishop.label: Deflect Route

genji-queen.label: Shimada Overclock

genji-king.label: Deflecting Crown

junkrat-queen.label: RIP-Tire Gambit

junkrat-king.label: Last Laugh Escape

roadhog-pawn.label: Chain Hook Shuffle

roadhog-rook.label: Whole Hog Bastion

roadhog-knight.label: Take a Breather

roadhog-bishop.label: Hookline Ambush

roadhog-queen.label: Scrapstorm Throne

roadhog-king.label: Bodyguard Crown
roadhog-king.description: The king may dash two clear cardinal squares once; its first capture grants another turn.

tracer-rook.label: Blink Bastion

tracer-knight.label: Triple Blink

tracer-bishop.label: Chronal Flank
tracer-bishop.description: Each bishop gains one knight leap and shields itself after a capture.

tracer-queen.label: Pulse Matrix
tracer-queen.description: The queen gains one extended 3-by-1 leap and shields herself after capturing.

tracer-king.label: Recall the Crown

bomb-king-queen.label: King Bomb Decree

bomb-king-king.label: His Majesty's Fuse

drogoz-pawn.label: Booster March

drogoz-rook.label: Salvo Flight

drogoz-knight.label: Wyrm Jet

drogoz-queen.label: Dragon's Judgement

drogoz-king.label: Thrust Escape

moji-pawn.label: Scamper Caravan

moji-queen.label: Bon Appetit

moji-king.label: Po-Li Escort
moji-king.description: The king may dash two clear diagonal squares once and shields adjacent allies after moving.

raum-pawn.label: Soul Armor Retreat

raum-rook.label: Juggernaut Gate

raum-knight.label: Cataclysm Step

raum-bishop.label: Abyssal Corridor

raum-queen.label: Soul Harvest Dominion
